annotations.title: Record fund balances from a report

description: Transcribe what a pension, hishtalmut, provident or managers’-insurance report says into the document — **several readings in one call**. Each entry names a fund by fund_id or by name, and carries one reading: the balance and its date, plus whatever else the report printed. A name that matches no fund creates it, once per batch, so four quarterly reports for one fund are four entries naming the same fund. **Leave out anything the report did not state** — an empty field means "not stated", and a 0 would be read as a stated zero. **Dry-runs by default**: it returns what it would write and writes nothing until called again with commit true. The document is copied to a timestamped .bak first. Editing a fund or correcting a reading already written is app-only.

commit.description: Default false. False previews the batch; true writes it.

path.description: Absolute path to a .emd file on this machine.

readings.description: One entry per reading. Up to 60 in a call.

agreed_return_basis_points.description: A yearly return the provider agreed to in writing, in **basis points**: 4% is 400. Only a rate in the contract; an expected return is an assumption and goes nowhere here.

as_of_date.description: The date the reading is of, as YYYY-MM-DD.

deposits.description: The report’s per-deposit table (פירוט ההפקדות), one entry per row, where it prints one. This is the most valuable thing on a pension report after the balance: every row names the salary month it is **for**, which is what turns "the quarter is ₪2,000 short" into "February never arrived". Transcribe the rows as printed and leave the field out entirely if the report has no such table. Rows repeated by a later year-to-date report are fine — the document counts each deposit once.

deposit_date.description: When the money reached the fund, as YYYY-MM-DD.

employee.description: תגמולי עובד — the employee’s own contribution.

employer_name.description: Who paid it in, as the row prints it.

salary.description: The salary the deposit was computed on, if printed.

salary_month.description: REQUIRED. The salary month this deposit is **for**, as YYYY-MM — not the month it arrived. A row without it is refused rather than stored, because it would count towards the fund and towards no month.

total.description: The row’s own total column, where the table prints one. Leave it out rather than adding the three up: the document derives that itself.

deposits_since_previous.description: What the fund says it **received** since the previous reading. This is the number the paychecks get compared against, so it is the single most valuable field here. May be negative — a severance withdrawal is recorded as exactly that.

employee_component.description: The employee’s component, where the report breaks it out.

employer_component.description: The employer’s component, where the report breaks it out.

employer_name.description: Which job this fund belongs to.

fee_negotiated_until.description: YYYY-MM-DD. Fee agreements expire and silently revert to the default rate, which is exactly the thing nobody notices.

fee_on_accumulation_basis_points.description: דמי ניהול מהצבירה, in **basis points** a year: 0.5% is 50, 1.05% is 105.

fee_on_deposit_basis_points.description: דמי ניהול מהפקדה, in basis points of each contribution.

fees_charged_since_previous.description: What the fund says it charged over the same period, which is what makes the measured fee possible.

first_deposit_date.description: YYYY-MM-DD. For a study fund this is what the six-year withdrawal date is counted from, and nothing else can work it out.

fund_type.description: One of PENSION, STUDY_FUND, PROVIDENT, MANAGERS_INSURANCE, PROVIDENT_FOR_INVESTMENT. Required only when creating a fund.

institution_id.description: The managing company, by id from `funds`.

investment_track.description: What the report calls the track, as free text.

name.description: The fund by name instead. Matches an existing fund case-insensitively; matches nothing and the fund is created, which also needs `fund_type`.

policy_number.description: For reference and for matching future statements.

return_since_previous.description: The return figure the report prints. Never one the app computed.

severance_component.description: The severance (פיצויים) component. Its tax and withdrawal rules differ from the other two, so it is never folded into them.

status.description: One of ACTIVE, DORMANT, CLOSED. Default ACTIVE. DORMANT is a fund from a previous job that takes no new deposits and still charges fees — worth setting, because it is also what tells the deposit check that nothing arriving is correct.

total_balance.description: The total balance the report prints, in major units.

name: record_fund_readings
title: Record fund balances from a report
